title.en: Which machine is the plaster sprayer?

description.en: M9: 380 V/50 Hz, 30 L/min, 50 bar, 25 mm hose, hopper 115 L, particle ≤ 4 mm, 50 m / 20 m, 200 kg. It is not a concrete pump.
description.zh: M9：380V/50Hz、30 L/min、50 bar、管径 25 mm、料斗 115 L、粒径 ≤ 4 mm、50 m / 20 m、200 kg。它不是混凝土泵。

h1.en: Which machine is the plaster sprayer?

directAnswer.en: M9. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the M9 automatic plaster spraying machine for gypsum or plaster inside 30 L/min and ≤ 4 mm: 380 V/50 Hz, 50 bar, hose 25 mm, hopper 115 L, loading height 90 cm, 50 m horizontal / 20 m vertical, 1230 × 720 × 1550 mm and 200 kg. Output is in litres per minute, not m³/h.
directAnswer.zh: M9。邢台河北品锦机械把 M9 全自动石膏喷涂机列为 30 L/min 和 ≤ 4 mm 内的石膏或抹灰：380V/50Hz、50 bar、管径 25 mm、料斗 115 L、上料高度 90 cm、水平 50 m / 垂直 20 m、外形 1230 × 720 × 1550 mm、200 kg。输送量用升/分钟，不是 m³/h。

heading.en: Do not convert 30 L/min into a pump output
heading.zh: 不要把 30 L/min 换成泵的输送量

body.en: The cell is 30 L/min. A trailer pump such as Electric 20 prints 8–10 m³/h. Those units are not interchangeable on this page, and M9’s particle limit is ≤ 4 mm. Interior finishing that is actually a concrete pipeline pour belongs on a pump page.
body.zh: 这一格是 30 L/min。电动20这类拖泵印的是 8–10 m³/h。在本页上这些单位不能互换，而且 M9 的粒径上限是 ≤ 4 mm。室内作业如果实际上是混凝土管道浇筑，就去泵的页面。

heading.en: No 380 V/50 Hz means M9 is the wrong row

body.en: The diesel concrete sprayer is not a plaster substitute. It prints 5 m³/h and ≤ 6 mm. Type 311 can run on 220/380 V but it is fine mortar at ≤ 2 mm and 2 m³/h, with only 5 m vertical. Plaster that needs the 115 L hopper and 30 L/min stays on M9 and needs the printed supply.
body.zh: 柴油混凝土喷涂机不是石膏的替代品。它印的是 5 m³/h 和 ≤ 6 mm。311 可以用 220/380V，但它是 ≤ 2 mm、2 m³/h 的细砂浆，垂直只有 5 m。需要 115 L 料斗和 30 L/min 的石膏，留在 M9，并需要已印的电源。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Send particle size and confirm 380 V/50 Hz. Do not send a concrete m³/h figure for this machine. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请发送粒径并确认 380V/50Hz。不要给这台机器发送混凝土的 m³/h。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: What is 50 bar in the table?
question.zh: 表上的 50 bar 是什么？

answer.en: It is the printed maximum outlet pressure for M9. Other sprayers print MPa. Do not convert it into an unpublished MPa claim on this page.
answer.zh: 它是 M9 已印的最大出口压力。其他喷涂机印的是 MPa。不要在本页把它换算成一个未公布的 MPa 说法。

question.zh: 上料高度是 90 cm 吗？

answer.en: Yes, as printed, with a 115 L hopper.

question.en: Is M9 the only plaster machine?
question.zh: M9 是唯一的石膏机吗？

answer.en: It is the machine the spraying page and the FAQ name for automatic plaster. Other rows are mortar or concrete spraying.
answer.zh: 它是喷涂页和问答里点名的全自动石膏机。其他行是砂浆或混凝土喷涂。
